summary: Layer/folder HSL and levels; non-destructive baseline. Folder masks, group opacity/blends and effect-order compatibility remain open.
Layer/folder curves and blur baseline; no broad closure of all group effects.
Named brush sections and custom image tips, jitter/rotation/count/pressure, portable v12. Custom-tip alpha lock unsupported; proprietary brush import remains open.
Portable v13 grain and Splatter/Sprinkle brushes plus measured capacity/recovery. 32-layer document cap retained; renderer-only 50-layer measurements do not establish interactive capacity.

Processed-group retention <=16MiB within 80MiB backing cap; exact reference pixels and conservative fallback. Warm renderer-only 50-layer ~231ms DPR1/~527ms DPR2; device/interactive acceptance remains open.

Portable v14 Motion Trace path/camera cues and manual/timed playback, Pause/Stop/restore and one-Undo Commit. Same-layer mixed region/original-object cue invalidation remains open; region commit rasterizes undoably.

Opt-in completed-operation timelapse recording and read-only replay/scrub/step, 0.5–4x playback and idle skip; paused reload/resume gap, per-board isolation and backup/import/confirmed attachment/discard. Separate IndexedDB schema1; 2000 states/32MiB per board/128MiB global payload, four snapshots/32MiB queue, atomic CAS/tombstones. Native board JSON excludes recording. Continuous pen animation, video export/framing and device/long-session acceptance remain open.
